answer: Spiral Attention Sybil Resistance enforces a minimum sustained attention cost through a comet-like trail of interactions. Each identity must continuously engage with the ecosystem, leaving a persistent oasis of activity that attackers cannot easily replicate. The mechanism requires real-time participation, making it prohibitively expensive to maintain fake identities. Attackers face a steep per-identity cost as they must divert attention from other opportunities to sustain false presences.
